9: Design a test suite for a line/letter/character counter tool.
10: 
11: This is a special exercise. Instead of creating code that works with
12: an existing test suite you get to define the test suite. To help you
13: several variations of the code under test have been provided, your
14: test suite should at least be able to detect the problems (or lack
15: thereof) with them.
16: 
17: The system under test is supposed to be a system to count the
18: number of lines, letters and total characters in supplied strings.
19: The idea is that you perform the "add string" operation a number
20: of times, passing in strings, and afterwards call the "lines",
21: "letters" and "characters" functions to get the totals.
